title: FlowsFile
description: v1/flows/rolling-7d.json and v1/flows/rolling-30d.json. Hourly cross-border flows per border. Physical (measured) flows and scheduled exchanges (planned trade) are separate series.

BorderSeries.title: BorderSeries
BorderSeries.description: One series for one border. Value in MW (hourly average). Positive = net flow from from_zone to to_zone; negative = the other way. Each border appears once per kind, in one direction only.

kind.description: physical = measured cross-border physical flow (states measured, modelled or missing). scheduled = day-ahead scheduled commercial exchange, shown as 'planned trade' (states planned or missing).
